summary: Updated the surfaces that described the pre-slice pipelines. Ansible (7610304 on phase/020-docs): CLAUDE.md, README, live-infra-access.md, the iac-agent README and runbook, slice-testing-strategy.md and a project.yaml comment now say iac-on-push lints (strict ansible-lint) and validates before it plans, and k8s-upgrade.md gains the step to move HelmCharts' KUBE_VERSION with prd's channel. AnsibleSpecs (7d608c3 on main, staged by name): decisions.md gains a push-pipeline gate rule, the argo-cd set lists nine refusing verbs with lint, and design.md names the gate. HelmCharts (031aab7) and the provider README (666b6a1) are committed on their local mains and unpushed (close-out A3); S14-S16 record the doc debt left open. Gates: kc project lint and kc project test are green in Ansible, and kc project test and poetry check --lock are green in HelmCharts. Unverified claims: none.
